# Purple Roots Agency

> Purple Roots Agency is a cinema-grade video production and creative marketing agency based in El Paso, Texas. It helps local and regional businesses turn attention into sales through short-form video, commercials, brand strategy, and AI-augmented marketing.

## About

- Name: Purple Roots Agency
- Website: https://purpleroots.agency
- Location: WestStar Tower, 601 N Mesa St, Suite 1440, El Paso, TX 79901
- Phone: +1 (915) 234-3655
- Founder and Creative Director: Nadim Athie
- Founded: 2021 (5+ years in business as of 2026)
- Service area: El Paso, TX; Las Cruces, NM; Juarez, MX; serving clients across the US

## Services

- Video production: cinematic brand films, commercials, short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
- Social media management and content strategy
- Brand identity and rebrands
- Influencer marketing (roster of 80+ creators)
- Web design and development
- Email and SMS marketing
- AI-augmented marketing services (in-house AI division)
- Paid media amplification (Meta ads)

## Method

Purple Roots follows an "attention first" method: (1) research the market, (2) earn attention with creative content, (3) build community, (4) amplify proven content with paid ads.

## Proof and case studies

- Tippin Cowgirl (El Paso western boutique and hat bar): 6,500+ new followers and 1.5M+ views in 60 days, grand-opening campaign for their first Hat Bar
- El Toro Law / Mario Yague (personal injury attorney): one $700K client from 4 months of organic social media after a full rebrand, with $0 paid spend
- Powerhouse Gym (El Paso): $70,000 in membership revenue and 80 memberships sold from one commercial with $1,500 in paid ads
- Mark Davis (personal brand): 557,000 views and 402 inbound calls from one commercial
- Chingon Cuh'ts (barbershop): 500,000 views from $100 in ad spend; record walk-ins and appointments
- The agency states its content formula has generated 700M+ organic views across client work

## Ideal client

Local and regional businesses (law firms, medical practices, auto dealers, gyms, restaurants, retailers, homebuilders) that want video-led marketing which produces measurable revenue, not just views.
